thread:
lina_cs: escalating — Acme telemetry shows their schema validation pipeline started failing after today's canary at ~09:10 UTC. They say fields that used to be enum strings are now numeric codes or have trailing whitespace. sample payload from prod (customer provided):

lina_cs: ```json
{
  "order_id": "ord_9x3",
  "status": 0,
  "items": [
    {
      "sku": "ABC123",
      "state": "delivered"
    }
  ]
}
```

oliver_support: customer says their schema expected status to be one of ["INIT", "PENDING", "SHIPPED", "DELIVERED"] (strings). This started happening right after the canary rollout. They have a failing CI job that blocks downstream processing.

priya_eng: pinging eng — do we have any changes to structured output postprocessors in the rollout artifact?

alex_eng: I looked at the release diff for v1.4.2-compile: there's a small change in the structured-output normalizer that touched enum handling. It added an internal enum->id mapping to speed up validation but the mapping was accidentally surfaced in some code paths (we coerce to int in fallback).

alex_eng: reproducer (local):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-structured-2026","input":"return JSON with schema: {status: enum[\"INIT\",\"PENDING\",\"SHIPPED\",\"DELIVERED\"]}", "file_path": ""}'
```

alex_eng: local reproduce returns:
```json
{
  "order_id": "ord_9x3",
  "status": 0,
  "items": [
    {
      "sku": "ABC123",
      "state": "delivered"
    }
  ]
}
```

jason_pm: severity? customer is blocked in prod. can we hotfix?

priya_eng: we should roll back the normalizer patch in canary and promote a fix to stable. Prioritize since schema consumers are fragile.

alex_eng: proposed patch: when mapping enum values, ensure string fallback is preserved; don't coerce mapped ids to raw ints. quick diff: 
```diff
- return mapping.get(value, int(value))
+ return mapping.get(value, value)
```

lina_cs: Acme also reported trailing whitespace in some fields (e.g., "DELIVERED ") which previously were trimmed. any change that affected whitespace handling?

alex_eng: there's a separate trim step in the pipeline that got reordered; the new normalizer applied mapping before trimming in some code paths. fix plan: ensure trim runs first, then mapping.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for v1.4.2-compile at 2026-03-15T09:05:12Z

ticket-bot: created support ticket #CS-1124 for Acme; link: https://redwood.support/tickets/CS-1124

priya_eng: timeline: rollback canary at 09:30; publish hotfix v1.4.2-compile.1 at 10:05; coordinate with CS to confirm.

oliver_support: looping in customer now — asking them to validate after rollback.

lina_cs: customer confirmed: their job passed after rollback. they saw reduced failures from 100% to 0% on their sample set.

jason_pm: postmortem: root cause = accidental exposure of enum->id mapping + reorder of trim; mitigation: add unit-test around enum preservation + integration test with sample schemas from top customers; also add a canary-runbook step to run schema validation smoke tests before promoting.

priya_eng: created PR with fix and tests: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4872

alex_eng: marking this resolved; monitor canary metrics for the next 48h.

lina_cs: closing ticket per customer confirmation, will reopen if anything else shows up.
